messages:
Liam (growth): idea: put a tiny cost estimator next to quickstarts (docs) — low friction. also use this as a micro-experiment to test alternate tier names: current names feel formal. propose testing 'Seed / Pro / Dedicated' vs existing. quick takes? :seedling:
Sofia (content): love the human tone. 'Seed' signals small teams. copy proposal: CTA = 'Estimate your monthly bill' and microcopy under results: 'Estimates assume standard tokenization and no fine-tuning.'
Ethan (analytics): baseline: quickstarts -> signup conversion = 1.9%. pricing page -> 4.6%. goal lift = +0.6pp. plan: run randomized A/B across quickstart families (python, node, curl). track `estimator_shown`, `variant`, `recommended_tier`, `result_usd`.
Nora (design): mock uploaded: https://figma.com/file/estimator-inline — compact single-field, result chip, small FAQ accordion. Variant A shows Seed/Pro/Dedicated; Variant B shows Launch/Scale/Enterprise.
Maya (sales): routing rules: if estimator returns Dedicated or Enterprise recommendation, mark lead `priority=high` and route to AE. For Seed and Pro, route to self-serve nurture flows. Please include `suggested_route` in payload.
Liam (growth): sample event/payload to include in webhook (for infra): ```{
  "session_id": "<anon>",
  "monthly_tokens": 50000,
  "estimate_usd": 25,
  "recommended_tier": "Seed",
  "suggested_route": "nurture",
  "referrer": "quickstart-node"
}```
Ethan (analytics): good. also add `experiment_name=quickstart-inline-estimator` and `variant`. I'll set up dashboard and retention window 14 days for paid upsell.
Nora (design): UX note — show short rationale tooltip on recommended tier: e.g., 'Estimated usage fits Seed tier (<=100k tokens/mo)'. Avoid overwhelming the quickstart canvas.
Sofia (content): micro-FAQ lines: billing cadence, invoice vs card, data retention policy, can we map to our FAQ anchor id for SEO. Also add tiny link `Read full pricing FAQ` under estimator.
Maya (sales): webinar idea: 20-min 'How billing works at Redwood' for customers who see Dedicated/Enterprise suggestion — include signup CTA in estimator when tier=Dedicated. We'll prep slides and a short Q&A.
DeployBot: rollout plan created: feature-flagged, Canary 5% quickstart traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 48h. Staging test passed.
Liam (growth): timeline: dev sprint this week, analytics hook next Tue, run 3 weeks. we'll reconvene after 7 days to inspect early signals. Anyone want to volunteer to write the quick FAQ snippet?
Sofia (content): I'll draft and share before EOD tomorrow.
Maya (sales): I'll draft routing spec and example Intercom payload for infra.
Liam (growth): perfect — thanks all. :rocket:
